items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: I always liked to play with Turk... after you worked with Earl Hines, you worked for a bit with Turk Murphy.

ctx.x: Wonderful. I always liked to play with Turk, wonderful fella he was to me, anyhow.
It was a happy kind of music he played. How long did you work with Turk?
